name: job-apply-app
description: Root runner for Job Apply App

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,MOBILE" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run start --prefix Back-end" "npm run dev --prefix Front-end" "npm run start --prefix Mobile-App"
scripts.all:web: npx concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,MOBILE_WEB" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run start --prefix Back-end" "npm run dev --prefix Front-end" "npm run web --prefix Mobile-App"
